text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was on a day off during intensive 
training for the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing by the training track, I 
spotted Special Week doing some voluntary 
training with her friends...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I did it... a personal best...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haa... phew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Seiun Sky—Special Week's classmate. An 
Umamusume who seems mild-mannered, yet 
occasionally shows a remarkably sharp 
gaze.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you really got me. Spe-chan, your 
skills have really improved, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I didn't just get faster, 
but that I've gotten way better at racing 
overall!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Ehehe, hearing that from 
Sei-chan, who's so good at mind games, 
makes me so happy~...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Kisaragi Sho the other day 
seemed to be a big deal too... Lately, I 
feel like I'm finally starting to 
understand how to run!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~. Sounds like your condition 
is shaping up great for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, I can't afford to slack off!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm? Sei-chan, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, it's nothing. Just thinking, 'I'm 
gonna do my best too!' or something like 
that."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, thanks for running with me. 
See ya~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, see ya in the classroom!
choice_data_list: Good work, Spe, that was a great run.

Good work, Spe, that was a great run, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I praised Special Week after she finished 
her solo training and decided to buy her a 
drink.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp, gulp... Phaaah!* That hits the spot 
so darn good~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: Something like this is an easy fix.
Something like this is a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, not just this juice... our daily 
training as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I got a good result in the Kisaragi Sho 
too, so it really makes me feel like I'm 
getting stronger!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I used to just run by myself out in the 
countryside all the time, so I don't have 
much experience, and there were times I 
felt uneasy, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You teach me so many things every single 
day, Trainer! I'm really starting to gain 
confidence!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, high spirits indeed. You're raring 
to go, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Symboli Rudolf――the student council 
president of Tracen Academy, possessing 
overwhelming ability.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...!? P-President!! Um, h-hello!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to be so tense. Forgive 
me for interrupting your pleasant chat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to praise you all, so I 
ended up calling out to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Special Week's recent 
breakthroughs have truly been a sight to 
behold.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is the fruit of Special Week's daily 
dedication, and... your relentless 
encouragement as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, th-that's exactly it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I'm boxed in by the pack, blocked 
from moving forward, or struggling for 
breath as my stamina runs dry... Your face 
comes to mind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then, the strength came rushing back 
to my legs! Because I'm not alone, I can 
give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mm. An Umamusume charging across the turf 
toward glory, and the Trainer who serves 
as her supporting cane... A truly ideal 
pair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way—is your next goal the "Japanese 
Derby"?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If I want to become the best horse 
girl in Japan, it was a race I just had to 
win...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, that sounds good. Special Week, for 
you as well—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I pray that the result will be one 
that makes your precious Trainer proud as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...! To Trainer, that's very...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘Becoming the trainer of a Derby 
Umamusume is harder than becoming Prime 
Minister.’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you wish to answer his trust and 
devotion—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If you wish to answer her trust and 
devotion—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's probably no stage more fitting for 
that than the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Symboli Rudolf, I 
walked Special Week back to her dorm under 
the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... N-No!! Um, it's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for walking me back! Well then, 
see you tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—I watched her back as she walked away, 
seemingly lost in thought.”
